title: The report chart follows the report's date and person filters
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. At least two technicians appear in this location's Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization charts (they have clocked time in the period you look at). At least two service advisors appear in this location's Billing Efficiency / Advisor Analysis chart (they have invoiced work with clocked time in the period you look at).
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top bar and click Advisor Analysis in the left menu.
  2. Read the months along the bottom of the chart and the legend.
  3. Change the Date control to Last year.
  4. Read the months along the bottom of the chart.
  5. In the Advisor filter choose one advisor (any advisor in the list).
  6. Read the chart's legend and lines.
  7. Click Technician Utilization in the left menu.
  8. In the Technician filter keep one technician (any technician in the list) and read the chart.
  9. Click Technician Efficiency and change its Date control to Last quarter, then read the chart's dates.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • After changing the report's date, the chart's dates change to the same range (e.g. Last year shows the months of last year).
  • After choosing one advisor, the chart shows only that advisor's line.
  • On Technician Utilization the chart shows only the kept technician.
  • On Technician Efficiency the chart's dates follow the Last quarter range. If the report offers a technician choice (it may sit under the ⋯ menu), the chart follows it too; write where you found it.
